item.title: Nike Ultra-Cozy Expedition Slipper Is Wonderfully Woven, Japan-Style
item.description: Nike ACG has been relaunched & it's looking promising. Enter, the Nike ACG Rufus SE in a Japanese-style floral finish.

item.title: Vans' En-Point(y) Ballet-Skate Shoe Is Elegantly Flat
item.description: The Vans Point Shoe carries classic Vans DNA while a new sole unit has completely reshaped the design.

item.title: Converse's Preppy Boat Shoe Is Surprisingly Skateable Still
item.description: After a string of out-there designs, Converse is turning heads again. This time, it’s with the Converse Marinestar boat shoe.

item.title: How "Crazy" Can Black Dr. Martens Really Be?
item.description: How crazy can all-black Dr. Martens shoes be? Allow Japanese retail giant BEAMS to show you with its Dr. Martens Lowell collaboration.

item.title: Nike’s LD-1000 Sneaker Looks Delicious Naked
item.description: Aritzia's Nike’s LD-1000 sneaker is the leather footwear embodiment of Gen Z's corpcore ethos.

item.title: Nike’s Thickest Running Shoe Is a Creamy Extra-Large Matcha Latte
item.description: Nike's Vomero Plus running sneaker surfaces in a "Jade Horizon" colorway, resulting in a matcha-level take on the model.

item.title: Warning: Nike’s Clean Basketball Sneaker Is Very Minty, Very Fresh
item.description: Nike's Sabrina 3 "Warning Label" sneaker brings dangerously fresh, minty looks to the court. Here's everything on the clean colorway.

item.title: Nike's Flyest Soccer Sneaker Wears a Dapper Dark Denim Suit
item.description: Nike's Total 90 sneaker slips on black denim jeans for its latest release, advancing its stylish revival era.

item.title: New Balance's Stylish “Miu Miu” Sneaker Goes Moo
item.description: atmos Pink debuts a New Balance 204L "Cowgirl" sneaker collaboration featuring cow-print designs.

item.title: The Delicious Denim-ification of adidas' Italian Sneaker
item.description: adidas' Italia 70s sneaker continues its denim era, appearing in another denim look. Here's everything on the latest sneaker.
